description: Renovate opens `fix(deps)`/`chore(deps)` PRs. They carry the no-changelog label so the PR checks (.github/workflows/pr.yml) don't demand a CHANGELOG entry per bump; the release summarises dependency updates instead. Bots are exempt from the linked-issue rule.

packageRules.description: Group non-major updates into a single PR
Require manual review for major bumps

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
